title: Normalise relative paths for both Windows and Linux

brief.goal: Add `toPortablePath(p)` to src/paths.ts: convert backslashes to forward slashes, collapse `./` and repeated slashes, strip a trailing slash, and throw an Error for absolute paths (leading slash or drive letter) or any `..` segment.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test

expected_clean_output: toPortablePath normalises separators and segments and rejects absolute and parent paths.

seeded_defect.description: Backslashes are not converted, so Windows-style input comes back unchanged.
